description: Review whether the latest numeric metric departure persists after accounting for its historical linear association with measurement sample size. Use when both a dashboard metric and its coverage denominator are available; choose did_it_change when no denominator is known. Requires at least ten aligned pairs; shorter valid arrays return NOT_ENOUGH_HISTORY. The latest pair is excluded from the historical fit. Returns verdict, assessment, reading and, when estimable, metric_delta in input units, standardized departures, sample_size_change_pct as a percent of the historical median, fit and departure_after_conditioning. Prefer assessment/validity over legacy REAL or SAMPLING_ARTIFACT labels: linear association neither proves a sampling cause nor excludes confounding. Constant or weakly related histories can return UNCLEAR and null standardized values. Unequal array lengths or nonpositive sample sizes return a tool error.

sample_sizes.description: Positive measurement denominators aligned one-for-one with values. Equal array length is required. Zero coverage is missing data, not a valid denominator; economic trading volume is not measurement coverage.

values.description: Chronological metric readings in consistent units, one per sample_sizes entry. At least 10 aligned pairs are needed; all earlier pairs form the reference for the latest reading.

name: real_or_sampling

anyOf.description: Existing tool-error payload; no successful result fields are implied.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

outputSchema.description: Short histories omit departure/fit fields; later branches retain only quantities that were computed. Tool errors retain the separate error-message shape.

assessment.description: Preferred interpretation of the legacy verdict.

denominator_extrapolation.description: Latest denominator falls outside the historical range.

anyOf.description: Robust standardized latest residual after linear conditioning.

departure_after_conditioning.description: Robust standardized latest residual after linear conditioning. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

error.description: Validation or computation failure message; inspect MCP isError or the HTTP status.

correlation.description: Historical linear correlation, rounded to three decimals.

guarantee.description: No statistical or market-performance guarantee is made.

metric_delta.description: Latest metric minus historical median, in input units.

metric_departure.description: Robust standardized latest metric departure. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

reading.description: Explanation and limits of the result.

sample_size_change_pct.description: Denominator change as percent of its historical median.

sample_size_departure.description: Robust standardized denominator departure. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

validity.description: Descriptive assessment, not a probability or statistical certificate.
